title: A dependency the app injects into CoreApi needs a test through serve
rule: When the desktop shell injects a platform service into fm-core (a with_* builder call in fm_app_lib::serve or run), add a src-tauri test that calls serve(...) and makes one API request whose answer differs with and without the service (for example NotFound instead of Unsupported), so removing the wiring fails a test. fm-core tests that inject the service by hand do not prove the app does.
rationale: E21.2 (#144): the app's with_pdf_printer wiring in serve had no test; deleting it would have made every PDF export answer Unsupported with the suite green.
